meta.unit_note: 各货币对美元的汇率（1 美元可兑换的该货币数量）。黄金原序列为美元/金衡盎司，换算为 原价 × 当日汇率。
meta.aligned_with: prices.prices 的日期一一对应，已对缺测日做向前填充。

CNY.primary_source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, H.10 Foreign Exchange Rates (noon buying rates in New York City). FRED series DEXCHUS.
CNY.fallback_after_primary_end: European Central Bank euro reference rates (via Frankfurter), 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-19 trading days. ECB did not publish 2026-11-14–15 (weekend).

EUR.primary_source: European Central Bank euro reference rates, retrieved via Frankfurter API (derived as USD base).

GBP.primary_source: European Central Bank euro reference rates, retrieved via Frankfurter API (derived as USD base).

JPY.primary_source: European Central Bank euro reference rates, retrieved via Frankfurter API (derived as USD base).
